verdict.rationale: Logseq's docs confirm you can type `(())` to reference a block on any page, which covers the core of block-level referencing. However, the evidence never mentions block or page embeds (transclusion), live syncing of edits between the source and the reference, or section-level referencing. Missing for 10: documented transclusion/embed of blocks, explicit confirmation that referenced content stays in sync, section-level referencing, independent hands-on corroboration.
